Chapter 6980: Celestial Immortal’S Source

Chapter 6980: Celestial Immortal’s Source

“Boom!” An explosion interrupted their astonishment.

The harmonization from a light similar to the bone’s aura was activated again. This was the power of a celestial immortal, far superior to anything else.

The ruby beam pierced through Ruin and extinguished numerous tribulations. The bone in Li Qiye’s hand trembled violently, wanting to fly toward the beam.

“Heavenfall Path!” Tribulation Daoist and the emperors stared in a daze at the beam’s source.

“Rumble!” The fortress suddenly became radiant. Its engine ignited with flames as it flew toward the path with blinding speed.

“Something’s happening.” Tribulation Daoist murmured. The fortress has never moved from the sky ever since its appearance.

Li Qiye stared at the path and said: “Looks like the celestial source is found.”

He had extracted the tile’s memories and understood their goal. A celestial immortal’s body was more precious than anything.

After Heavenfall’s body was taken down, it fell into Heaven Pit. The blood, longevity, and essence accumulated and formed a celestial source.

Despite its value, finding it in Heaven Pit was a perilous task. However, the fortress race has been preparing for this for a long time now.

“Boom!” A majestic golden light on the path coiled around the beam. After metallic vibrations, more metallic rings coiled around it, connecting the path to the outside world.

Once the rings were completely interlocked, bolts of lightning emerged and firmly held them in place. Just like that, a stable passage was formed.

“What is going on...” Tribulation Daoist murmured.

“Using the celestial source to open a spatial channel, an army is coming.” Li Qiye said.

Meanwhile, the bone emitted a terrible force, wanting to escape from his grasp.

“Immortal, what to do with this bone?” Tribulation Daoist noticed it.

“This is not something you can keep. I will destroy it.” Li Qiye said before pressing his palms together against the bone.

“Boom!” It felt threatened and unleashed all of its power.

Nonetheless, Li Qiye still managed to stop the explosion and began crushing it. Once the last piece was left, a mournful wail could be heard.

Eventually, it was reduced to dust essences scattering throughout Survivor Realm.
